description:
Base on-chain read: a transaction by its hash. Base eth_getTransactionByHash. Takes hash (transaction hash, 0x + 64 hex) and returns that Base transaction as the node returns it: from, to, value, gas, gas price, input, nonce, block number and transaction index, or null if the node does not know the hash.

GET https://api.arysphere.com/v1/ventures/x402_chain_reads_v1/base_eth_gettransactionbyhash. Same payment terms as that HTTP route.
Call once with no payment. The result is the payment terms. Retry the same call with the signed payment at _meta["x402/payment"].
